title: Synthetic PB4T departmental negotiation and recurrence planning
description: Local synthetic-only planning board. Deterministic departmental agents exchange proposals and constraint responses with a shared coordinator; recurrence expands fictional interval rules and cross-week history. No operational integration or SFTRM assurance.

components.label: Weekly board and local review
components.description: Editable weekly allocations, negotiation trace, numeric heatmap, recurrence ledger, preserved drafts and local review; synthetic provenance.

components.label: Local HTTP and cancellation
components.description: Foundation health/invoke service and abortable worker; no external calendar or operational connection.

components.label: Simulated departmental agents and coordinator
components.description: Department-owned proposal generators respond to conflict feedback, coordinator reserves/retracts shared allocations and backtracks deterministically; exchanges precede search completion.

components.label: Synthetic recurrence expansion
components.description: Expand editable interval rules from last-completion history into stable occurrence IDs, release windows and deadlines; detect omitted mandatory occurrences before negotiation.

components.label: Shared hard constraints and loading
components.description: Qualified distinct crews, windows, resources, watch history, rest and duty budgets, coverage and numeric loads; one backend used by UI and tests.

components.label: Preserved fictional input records
components.description: Validated synthetic fixtures remain unchanged; input-only samples embedded in HTML. New editable synthetic rule examples supplement rather than replace them.

connections.label: Raw public protocol requests and cancellation
Complete allocation or failure plus independent exchange trace
